final: WITH g AS (SELECT orderslink AS oref, AVG(rebrate) AS avg_rate, AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_reb FROM fees WHERE orderslink IS NOT NULL GROUP BY orderslink), o AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rate) AS overall_avg FROM g WHERE avg_rate IS NOT NULL) SELECT g.oref, g.avg_rate, g.avg_reb, g.avg_rate - o.overall_avg AS diff FROM g CROSS JOIN o WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (g.avg_rate - o.overall_avg) IS NULL, (g.avg_rate - o.overall_avg) DESC LIMIT 10
